historical_result.preceding_snapshot_error: Step 5 returned a snapshot error while the tool wrapper reported success; step 7 subsequently returned a complete snapshot containing the target View link.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-7 followed by read-only DOM geometry observation; no target click

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 原始第 7 步快照已列出 Magento Blank 的 View 链接，但第 8 步按 :visible 点击超时。在相同的只读动作前缀下，官方 Moli 1.1.6 中链接及父元素均为零面积，固定候选中均为非零面积；两次探针都没有快照错误。该差异支持动态表格更新后旧布局快照被几何查询复用这一故障家族，而不能把第 5 步历史快照错误直接当作第 8 步超时的原因。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The original step-7 snapshot listed the Magento Blank View link, but the step-8 :visible click timed out. After the same read-only action prefix, both the link and its parent had zero-area rectangles in official Moli 1.1.6 and nonzero rectangles in the fixed candidate; neither probe had a snapshot error. This contrast supports the stale-layout-after-dynamic-table-update defect family, not a direct causal attribution from the historical step-5 snapshot error to the step-8 timeout.

scope_limit: The same-page probe used the current Rainbond deployment and official Moli 1.1.6, not the formal 1.1.3 binary. The layout defect family is reproduced; a commit-level bisect for this Magento page and same-environment post-fix formal task rerun were not performed. Historical formal score remains unchanged.
